material_findings.issue: The original_mixed branch omits an explicit non-injection check. The sealed mixed capture producer accepts invoke injection but does not record whether it was used in attempt/receipt. Mocked rc0 captures therefore share production schema and can satisfy staging operation/argv/source/log/summary checks.

material_findings.effect: The stated complete retained-tree boundary can be bypassed; payload checks then attest only the already-filtered shipped set.
material_findings.followup: Preserve v1 and add explicit role-to-kind law: whole evidence/code/source roles require tree, fixed single-file roles file, and group only permitted flat capture roles with basename-only members and a defined complete group inventory; add omitted diagnostic/empty-directory fixtures.
material_findings.issue: Asset kind is not constrained by role. group verifies only caller-listed files with declared empty directories, and even nested file keys are accepted. A whole original/preflight/witness/code evidence role may be a filtered group, omitting unreferenced failed logs, attempt metadata and directories while required cell/trace/proof subsets pass. Whole-tree rechecks apply only to kind tree.
